judgement.reason: The self-hosted product is a Python FastAPI memory server (server/dev.Dockerfile) plus a separate Next.js dashboard built from a different image, and the dashboard needs the API server running alongside it, so Deployz cannot run them as one web service.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares mem0 (builds server/dev.Dockerfile) in server/docker-compose.yaml, which mem0-dashboard needs. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The dashboard reaches the mem0 API server through API_INTERNAL_URL, and the API is a separate Python service built from another Dockerfile, so the shown lines do not prove the production app works without it.
